wins.text: AI semiconductor revenue quadrupled YoY to $2.3B in Q1, and full-year AI revenue outlook raised from >$7.5B to >$10B (35% of semiconductor revenue vs. prior 25% guide)
Consolidated Q1 revenue of $12B, up 34% YoY; infrastructure software revenue up 153% YoY to $4.6B driven by VMware consolidation
Networking revenue grew 46% YoY to $3.3B on strong AI accelerator and Tomahawk 5 800G switch demand; FY24 networking growth outlook raised to >35% from prior 30% guide
Software bookings surged from <$600M to $1.8B sequentially in Q1 and expected to exceed $3B in Q2, with VMware VCF upsell strategy gaining strong traction among top 2,000 strategic customers
Adjusted EBITDA of $7.2B at 60% of revenue; $7.2B in share repurchases completed in Q1, eliminating ~7.7M AVGO shares

risks.text: Broadband revenue declined 23% YoY to $940M in Q1; FY24 broadband outlook worsened to down ~30% YoY from prior guidance of down mid-teens YoY, with no recovery expected until late in the year
Server storage connectivity revenue fell 29% YoY to $887M; FY24 outlook revised to decline mid-20% range YoY vs. prior high-teens decline guide
Semiconductor gross margins compressed 190 bps YoY to ~67%, driven by AI accelerator product mix (HBM memory dilutes blended margins structurally)
Heavy customer concentration in AI ASIC business — only 2 hyperscale customers in production; a competitor based in Asia is publicly claiming potential share at Broadcom's largest customer
Gross debt of $75.9B post-VMware acquisition with $30B in floating-rate debt at 6.6% weighted average coupon; $658M in restructuring/integration spend pressuring near-term free cash flow

guidance_items.detail: FY2024 consolidated revenue guidance reiterated at $50B, representing ~40% YoY growth
FY2024 adjusted EBITDA margin guidance reiterated at 60% of revenue
FY2024 AI semiconductor revenue outlook raised to >$10B (35% of semi revenue) from prior >$7.5B (25%); networking segment growth outlook raised to >35% YoY from prior ~30%
FY2024 software revenue guidance reiterated at $20B; wireless revenue guided flat YoY; semiconductor solutions overall guided up mid-to-high single digits YoY
FY2024 broadband revenue revised to down ~30% YoY (from prior down mid-teens); server storage revised to down mid-20% YoY (from prior down high-teens)

analyst_concerns_not_in_prepared: Competitive threat from Asia-based rival claiming share at Broadcom's largest custom ASIC customer
Gross margin dilution mechanics of AI accelerator business (HBM memory cost pass-through)
Carbon Black strategy reversal — management had previously signaled divestiture but is now retaining and merging with Symantec
